perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Killing Wind
enhanced.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for an improved duration.

perks.name: Ensemble
perks.description: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

enhanced.name: Ensemble
enhanced.description: Substantially improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

enhanced.name: Quickdraw
enhanced.description: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast. Reload is improved.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

enhanced.name: Cluster Bomb
enhanced.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.

perks.name: Reconstruction
perks.description: This weapon slowly reloads itself over time, up to double capacity.

enhanced.name: Reconstruction
enhanced.description: This weapon reloads itself at an improved rate over time, up to double capacity.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

enhanced.name: Snapshot Sights
enhanced.description: Faster time to aim down sights. Stability is increased.

perks.name: Frenzy

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Turnabout
perks.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

enhanced.name: Turnabout
enhanced.description: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield for an improved duration.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

enhanced.name: Lasting Impression
enhanced.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Substantially increases blast radius and increases damage.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing

perks.name: Explosive Light
